title: Werkstudent*in Communications and Social Media
description: Das ISD ist ein globaler Think-and-Do-Tank, der sich dem Schutz von Demokratie und Menschenrechten widmet und Lösungen gegen instrumentalisierten Hass, Polarisierung, Desinformation und Extremismus weltweit entwickelt. Das ISD verbindet Forschung und Analyse mit Regierungsberatung sowie der Konzeption und Durchführung internationaler Trainings-, Bildungs- und Kommunikationsprogramme, um evidenzbasierte Antworten auf diese Herausforderungen umzusetzen. Die ISD-Teams sind in London, Amman, Berlin und Washington, DC angesiedelt. Warum für das ISD arbeiten? Das ISD ist kein gewöhnlicher Think Tank. Wir verwandeln Forschung in Maßnahmen, die die Welt verändern. Unsere Erkenntnisse verstauben nicht in Schubladen, sie stärken den Kampf für Demokratie und Menschenrechte an vorderster Front. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, echten Wandel zu bewirken, vom lokalen bis zum globalen Niveau. Wir suchen engagierte Menschen, die unsere Leidenschaft teilen, einen Unterschied zu machen. Werde Teil einer Organisation, die wirkliche Wirkung erzielt. Die Leitprinzipien des ISD – Integrität, Zusammenarbeit, Flexibilität und Courage – prägen, wer wir als Team und Organisation sind. Diese Prinzipien spiegeln unsere Kultur wider und leiten unser Handeln und unsere Entscheidungen.   Unsere Benefits Flexibles Arbeiten mit Home-Office nach Prinzipien von Vertrauen, Kommunikation und Flexibilität. Großzügige Urlaubsregelungen. 1 zusätzliche Woche bezahlter Urlaub über Weihnachten, zusätzlich zum regulären Urlaubsanspruch. title: Werkstudent:in Bioinformatik - Mikrobiom
description: Über die Position Als Werkstudent:in entwickelst du die bioinformatische Auswertung für ein Mikrobiom-Unternehmen, das wir gerade aufbauen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem wissenschaftlichen und technischen Team zusammen und überführst metagenomische Methoden in reproduzierbare Analysen, die wir im Produkt einsetzen können. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, wie verlässlich wir Mikrobiomdaten auswerten und wie gut sich die Ergebnisse nachvollziehen lassen. Deine Aufgaben Metagenomische Sequenzierungsdaten auswerten, von der Qualitätskontrolle bis zur taxonomischen und funktionellen Profilierung. Analysewerkzeuge und Referenzdatenbanken vergleichen und gemeinsam mit dem Team entscheiden, welche Methoden für unsere Fragestellungen geeignet sind. Bioinformatische Pipelines implementieren, testen und dokumentieren, damit sie sich mit neuen Datensätzen zuverlässig ausführen lassen. Analyseergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem wissenschaftlichen Team einordnen und methodische Grenzen sichtbar machen. Dein Profil Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang in Bioinformatik, Computational Biology oder einem verwandten Fach eingeschrieben. Du hast bereits selbst metagenomische Sequenzierungsdaten ausgewertet, zum Beispiel in einem Forschungsprojekt, einer Abschlussarbeit oder einem Praktikum. Erfahrung mit Shotgun-Metagenomik ist besonders relevant. Du arbeitest sicher mit Linux und der Kommandozeile und setzt bioinformatische Analysen in Python um. Du kannst erklären, warum du eine Analysemethode gewählt hast, wie du ihre Ergebnisse überprüfst und wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und kannst technische und wissenschaftliche Themen auf Englisch besprechen und dokumentieren. Erfahrung mit Workflow-Tools wie Nextflow oder Snakemake sowie mit dem Betrieb von Anwendungen oder Pipelines auf AWS ist ein Plus. Wenn du die bioinformatische Grundlage eines entstehenden Mikrobiom-Unternehmens mit aufbauen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Position liegt im Performance Marketing. Du verantwortest unsere Google-Ads-Kampagnen end to end: von der Auswahl geeigneter Kampagnenziele und -typen über Keywords, Zielgruppen, Budgets und Anzeigen bis zur laufenden Optimierung anhand von Leads und Conversions.

Dabei endet deine Arbeit nicht im Werbekonto. Du prüfst die gesamte Strecke bis zur Anfrage, passt Landingpages, Texte, Formulare und weitere Website-Inhalte im CMS an und verbesserst das Zusammenspiel zwischen Anzeige, Zielseite und Conversion. AI-Tools unterstützen dich über den gesamten Workflow hinweg: bei Recherche und Kampagnenplanung, bei Anzeigenvarianten und Website-Texten, bei Analysen sowie bei Skripten, Content-Adaptionen und der Postproduktion. Du entscheidest, was fachlich passt, prüfst Fakten und Qualität und bringst die Ergebnisse in eine belastbare Endfassung.

Als zweiter Bereich unterstützt du unsere Social-Media-Kommunikation mit eigenständig produziertem Foto- und Video-Content. Du entwickelst Themen, Skripte, Shotlists und Storyboards, planst Aufnahmen und setzt Inhalte von der Produktion bis zur Bildbearbeitung, zum Videoschnitt und zur Veröffentlichung selbst um.   • Du planst und produzierst Foto- und Videoaufnahmen von Produkten, Anwendungen, Vorführungen und Einsätzen

raw.title: Werkstudent*in Communications and Social Media
raw.description:
Das ISD ist ein globaler Think-and-Do-Tank, der sich dem Schutz von Demokratie und Menschenrechten widmet und Lösungen gegen instrumentalisierten Hass, Polarisierung, Desinformation und Extremismus weltweit entwickelt. Das ISD verbindet Forschung und Analyse mit Regierungsberatung sowie der Konzeption und Durchführung internationaler Trainings-, Bildungs- und Kommunikationsprogramme, um evidenzbasierte Antworten auf diese Herausforderungen umzusetzen. Die ISD-Teams sind in London, Amman, Berlin und Washington, DC angesiedelt.

Warum für das ISD arbeiten?

Das ISD ist kein gewöhnlicher Think Tank. Wir verwandeln Forschung in Maßnahmen, die die Welt verändern. Unsere Erkenntnisse verstauben nicht in Schubladen, sie stärken den Kampf für Demokratie und Menschenrechte an vorderster Front. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, echten Wandel zu bewirken, vom lokalen bis zum globalen Niveau. Wir suchen engagierte Menschen, die unsere Leidenschaft teilen, einen Unterschied zu machen. Werde Teil einer Organisation, die wirkliche Wirkung erzielt.

Die Leitprinzipien des ISD – Integrität, Zusammenarbeit, Flexibilität und Courage – prägen, wer wir als Team und Organisation sind. Diese Prinzipien spiegeln unsere Kultur wider und leiten unser Handeln und unsere Entscheidungen.

 Unsere Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeiten mit Home-Office nach Prinzipien von Vertrauen, Kommunikation und Flexibilität.

  • Großzügige Urlaubsregelungen.

  • 1 zusätzliche Woche bezahlter Urlaub über Weihnachten, zusätzlich zum regulären Urlaubsanspruch.

  • Home-Office-Zuschuss

Gehalt

€18 brutto pro Stunde

Arbeitsort

Der Arbeitsort kann unser Büro in Berlin sein oder in einer hybriden Arbeitsform nach Absprache. Die Bewerber*innen müssen über eine Arbeitsberechtigung für Deutschland verfügen. Eine Visa-Sponsoring-Möglichkeit besteht für diese Stelle nicht.

Vertragsart

Start: 04.01.2027; befristet bis 31.12.2027; Teilzeit 20 Stunden pro Woche

Gleichberechtigung, Vielfalt und Inklusion

ISD verpflichtet sich zur Förderung von Diversität in der gesamten Belegschaft und strebt ein Team an, das die Gesellschaft in all ihren Facetten widerspiegelt. Wir setzen alles daran, dass unser Arbeitsplatz, unsere Personalpolitik und unsere Organisationskultur ein inklusives, positives und fortschrittliches Umfeld schaffen, in dem alle Teammitglieder mit Würde und Respekt behandelt werden. Wir suchen ab sofort eine*n engagierte*n Werkstudent*in Communications & Social Media, der*die unser Kommunikationsteam in Berlin unterstützt. title: Senior Produktionscontroller (m/w/d)
description: Ihre neue Herausforderung als Senior Produktionscontroller (m/w/d) Sie kennen die Zahlen hinter einer Produktion und möchten künftig nicht nur analysieren, was passiert ist, sondern gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team mitgestalten, was als Nächstes kommt? Dann könnte diese Position gut zu Ihnen passen. Als erfahrene:r Produktionscontroller (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung für ein kleines, erfahrenes Team und bleiben gleichzeitig nah am operativen Tagesgeschäft. Ihr fachliches Know-how ist bei uns ebenso gefragt wie Ihre Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und die unterschiedlichen Stärken im Team zusammenzubringen. Unser Produktionscontrolling ist eng mit den Abläufen unserer Produktionsstandorte verzahnt. SAP bildet dabei das Herzstück unserer täglichen Arbeit und die zentrale Datenbasis für Abrechnung, Kalkulation und Analyse. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team möchten wir unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und die Möglichkeiten von Digitalisierung und Automatisierung noch stärker nutzen. Sie schauen gemeinsam, wo neue Lösungen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen, Abläufe erleichtern und mehr Raum für die analytischen Aufgaben des Controllings ermöglichen. Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie an unserem Standort in Hamburg-Wilhelmsburg: Sie übernehmen die fachliche Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres kleinen Teams im Produktionscontrolling, koordinieren Aufgaben und sorgen gemeinsam für verlässliche Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft. Sie verantworten die Abrechnung unserer Produktionsaufträge für die Abpackbetriebe der CAFEA-Gruppe, analysieren die Ergebnisse und arbeiten dabei eng mit unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Sie behalten Herstellkosten, Bestände sowie die Auftrags- und Kostenstellenrechnung im Blick und stellen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen eine verlässliche Datenbasis in SAP sicher. Sie verantworten Kalkulationsläufe sowie relevante Sonderauswertungen und interne Kalkulationen und leiten aus den Ergebnissen die passenden Fragestellungen und Handlungsbedarfe ab. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team entwickeln Sie Prozesse, Auswertungen und unser Berichtswesen weiter und nutzen Digitalisierung und Automatisierung dort, wo sie die tägliche Arbeit sinnvoll unterstützen. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihr Know-How in standortübergreifende CAFEA-Projekte ein und arbeiten mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Was Sie mitbringen Sie sind fachlich gerne mittendrin, können gleichzeitig den Überblick behalten und haben Freude daran, Menschen, Zahlen und Prozesse zusammenzubringen? Dann passen Sie möglicherweise ziemlich gut zu uns. Ob Ihr beruflicher Weg über ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium, eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung geführt hat, ist für uns dabei weniger entscheidend. Wichtig ist uns, dass Sie über fundierte Erfahrung im Controlling, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Werksumfeld, verfügen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sicher beurteilen können. Sie haben bereits erste Verantwortung für andere übernommen, beispielsweise als fachliche Führungskraft, Stellvertretung, Projektleitung oder in einem kleinen Team? Perfekt. Sie müssen bei uns keine langjährige Führungskarriere mitbringen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass Sie gerne Verantwortung übernehmen, Orientierung geben, zuhören und Ihr Wissen mit anderen teilen. Unser Angebot Digitalisierung gemeinsam gestalten: Wir möchten die Möglichkeiten neuer Technologien künftig noch stärker für unser Produktionscontrolling nutzen. Dabei setzen wir auf Lösungen, die zu unseren Prozessen und vor allem zu den Menschen passen, die täglich mit ihnen arbeiten. Bei uns erwartet Sie nicht nur ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch eine langfristige Perspektive in einem international tätigen Familienunternehmen. Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung, ergänzt durch Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld sowie regelmäßige Gehaltsanpassungen. Wir möchten, dass Sie sich bei uns langfristig wohlfühlen und Ihre Arbeit flexibel gestalten können. Deshalb bieten wir Ihnen moderne Arbeitsbedingungen mit Gleitzeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten. Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir fördern Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und externe Qualifizierungsangebote. Bei uns erhalten Sie Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung für spannende Projekte und Produkte zu übernehmen. Auch außerhalb des Arbeitsplatzes möchten wir etwas zurückgeben: Sie profitieren von Zuschüssen zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, JobRad, vermögenswirksamen Leistungen, Deutschlandticket sowie vergünstigten Sport- und Gesundheitsangeboten über machtfit. Karriere mit Geschmack: Sie erhalten monatliche Freikontingente, damit Sie auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee, Cappuccino und Trinkschokoladen genießen können. Damit nicht nur unsere Produkte überzeugen, sondern auch Ihr Arbeitsalltag angenehm bleibt, wird in unserer betriebseigenen Kantine täglich frisch gekocht. Dank unserer Kooperation mit dem Fürstenberg Institut erhalten Sie und Ihre Familienangehörigen Zugang zu professioneller und vertraulicher Beratung – bei beruflichen, privaten oder familiären Themen. Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen. Neben den vielfältigen Angeboten gehören auch kleine Aufmerksamkeiten zu Geburtstagen, Ostern, Nikolaus oder Weihnachten bei uns einfach dazu. Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen? Familiär. International. Langfristig. Besondere Qualität entsteht, wenn Tradition und Moderne miteinander harmonieren. Wir gehen respektvoll, offen und hilfsbereit miteinander um und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um erstklassige Kaffee-Spezialitäten zu produzieren. Bei der DEK arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Umfeld und spüren zugleich die Vorteile eines inhabergeführten Familienunternehmens. title: Senior Software Engineer- IAM & Billing (m/f/d)
description: At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH. As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign. Every tenant, every user, every permission on our sovereign cloud runs through the services this squad builds, and so does every euro that gets billed. We are the Business Logic squad in the Cloud Store team at gridscale, part of OVHcloud, and we build the backend layer of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform: identity and access management, consumption tracking and billing for enterprise customers who run their cloud on their own premises, often fully air-gapped. Our first fully integrated release is out, and the next step is taking it to production grade, while the platform is becoming the foundation on which other OVHcloud products build their sovereign offerings. The design decisions this squad makes over the next year will shape all of that, and we want you in the room when they are made. Our Tech Stack 🚀 · AI Coding Agents & Agentic Workflows · Python (async) · REST · PostgreSQL · Redis · Docker · Kubernetes · OAuth2/OIDC · Keycloak · OpenStack Your Role💻 As a senior engineer in the squad, you own backend services end to end, from the first design sketch to running in production on Kubernetes. You make architecture calls in a domain where correctness, security and backward compatibility are not optional: billing can't be "roughly right", and an auth bug is a security incident. You write down the decisions that matter, review your teammates' designs and code, and help the whole squad raise its engineering bar. We write code to be read: clear, maintainable and easy for the next person – human or agent – to change. Our tests exist to catch real bugs, not to turn the coverage badge green. On-call is shared across the squad, and our working language is English – no German required. For us, AI is a structural shift in how software is built, not an add-on. Agentic development runs through our entire lifecycle, from specification and design through implementation, testing and code review: AI agents do much of the work, while engineers set the direction, define the guardrails and own every merge. AI-assisted is our default - agents generate, engineers decide, every change is human-reviewed before it merges, and accountability always stays with the engineer. You already work this way every day and operate at the frontier of these tools: you know where agents excel, where they fail, and how to build workflows that deliver production-grade results in a domain where correctness and security are non-negotiable. With us, you'll push this practice further across the squad and beyond. Your Tasks Design and build Python services for IAM , consumption tracking and billing on OPCP, using AI agents across the full development lifecycle. Own your services end to end , from the first design sketch to production on Kubernetes , and share on-call with the squad. Shape the squad's agentic engineering practice : agent workflows, context and guardrails, review standards for AI-generated code , and how we measure the impact. Design our REST APIs so they can evolve without breaking the teams and customers who depend on them. Build authentication and authorization flows on OAuth2/OIDC . Make asynchronous, distributed workflows reliable: concurrency, retries, idempotency and partial failures. Drive technical design in the squad: make architecture calls, document key decisions and review your teammates' designs and code. Mentor other engineers and help the squad raise its engineering bar , including how it builds with AI agents. Work across squads ( Platform, Packagers, Experience ) and with OPCP Core on interfaces and contracts. What we offer you💼 Real influence on the architecture of a sovereign cloud platform at an early, formative stage – a platform in build mode with strong ownership. AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including agentic coding tooling and room to push our engineering practices further. An annual learning and conference budget . At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Every tenant, every user, every permission on our sovereign cloud runs through the services this squad builds, and so does every euro that gets billed. We are the Business Logic squad in the Cloud Store team at gridscale, part of OVHcloud, and we build the backend layer of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform: identity and access management, consumption tracking and billing for enterprise customers who run their cloud on their own premises, often fully air-gapped. Our first fully integrated release is out, and the next step is taking it to production grade, while the platform is becoming the foundation on which other OVHcloud products build their sovereign offerings. The design decisions this squad makes over the next year will shape all of that, and we want you in the room when they are made.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· AI Coding Agents & Agentic Workflows · Python (async) · REST · PostgreSQL · Redis

· Docker · Kubernetes · OAuth2/OIDC · Keycloak · OpenStack

Your Role💻

As a senior engineer in the squad, you own backend services end to end, from the first design sketch to running in production on Kubernetes. You make architecture calls in a domain where correctness, security and backward compatibility are not optional: billing can't be "roughly right", and an auth bug is a security incident. You write down the decisions that matter, review your teammates' designs and code, and help the whole squad raise its engineering bar. We write code to be read: clear, maintainable and easy for the next person – human or agent – to change. Our tests exist to catch real bugs, not to turn the coverage badge green. On-call is shared across the squad, and our working language is English – no German required.

For us, AI is a structural shift in how software is built, not an add-on. Agentic development runs through our entire lifecycle, from specification and design through implementation, testing and code review: AI agents do much of the work, while engineers set the direction, define the guardrails and own every merge. AI-assisted is our default - agents generate, engineers decide, every change is human-reviewed before it merges, and accountability always stays with the engineer. You already work this way every day and operate at the frontier of these tools: you know where agents excel, where they fail, and how to build workflows that deliver production-grade results in a domain where correctness and security are non-negotiable. Head of People Operation

Location: Karlsruhe, Germany (hybrid)

Company: ILOS Projects GmbH & Co. KG

Scope: Full-time, permanent

WHO ARE ILOS?

ILOS is a fast-growing renewable energy company with a strong presence across Europe, backed by BNP Paribas Asset Management Alts and committed to accelerating the energy transition. Since 2018, we have developed, built, and operated large-scale solar PV projects across seven core markets.

THE ROLE OVERVIEW

ILOS is seeking a hands-on Head of People Operations to lead and strengthen its HR function as the business grows across seven European markets. Reporting directly to the C-level leadership team, you will lead and develop the existing HR team while taking personal responsibility for complex people matters, operational quality and the foundations needed for a scalable international organisation.

Working closely with Finance, Legal, management, local advisers and the wider business, you will bring structure to payroll oversight, employment contracts, people-cost planning and HR processes. You will provide trusted, practical guidance to managers, develop consistent international standards and use reliable people data to support informed decisions and a positive employee experience.

TASKS

  • Lead and develop the HR team, providing hands-on support, clear responsibilities and quality assurance across onboarding, employee administration, contracts, payroll coordination and recruitment.
  • Oversee payroll and employment contracts, establishing a reliable four-eyes review process and coordinating with payroll providers, tax advisers, Legal and external counsel across relevant countries.
  • Manage complex employee-relations and employment-law matters, including performance, absence, parental leave, flexible working and exits, and advise managers with support from Legal or external counsel where needed.
  • Own headcount and personnel-cost planning with Finance, including budgets, forecasts, scenario analysis and cost-centre allocation; explain variances and provide clear insight to management.
  • Maintain accurate, complete employee and workforce data, including joiners, leavers, contract and salary changes and absences, and provide a reliable source of headcount and FTE information for reporting.
  • Develop meaningful HR KPIs and reporting, covering workforce costs, turnover, time-to-hire, absence and span of control, and support the data required for applicable pay-transparency reporting.
  • Standardise and document HR processes, improve Factorial and related systems, and establish practical performance, employee-development and compensation processes, including salary bands and job levels.
  • Develop consistent HR standards across ILOS’ European markets while respecting local employment requirements, and coordinate international employment matters with local advisers.


PROFILE

  • Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Business or Employment Law, or a comparable discipline.
  • At least 5 years of generalist HR experience in a comparable scale-up, mid-sized or project-based business, including experience building and improving HR structures.
  • Strong practical payroll knowledge, including wage tax, social security and continued pay, with the ability to review and oversee payroll rather than personally process every payroll run.
  • Practical experience with employment contracts, employee relations and complex HR matters, knowing when to involve Legal and external counsel.
  • Proven experience of headcount and personnel-cost planning with Finance, including budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, scenarios and management reporting.
  • Experience leading and developing an existing HR team, with a collaborative, hands-on approach and the ability to advise managers on sensitive people matters.
  • Experience in an international organisation, with the confidence to work with local advisers across different employment jurisdictions; knowledge of cross-border employment or collectively regulated markets would be advantageous.
  • Practical DATEV experience or a strong understanding of its HR, payroll and Finance interfaces; familiarity with Factorial or similar HR systems and salary-band or job-architecture development is advantageous. Fluent German and English are essential.


Become part of a committed team shaping the future of clean energy, together.

title: Intelligence Specialist (m/w/d)
description: FOREUS In einer Welt, in der Informationen im Überfluss vorhanden sind, wird die Fähigkeit, relevante Informationen zu identifizieren, zu verifizieren und miteinander in Verbindung zu bringen, zu einem entscheidenden strategischen Vorteil. FOREUS ist ein international ausgerichtetes Private Intelligence Unternehmen, das nachrichtendienstliche Methoden, modernste Technologien und menschliche Analysekompetenz miteinander verbindet. Wir untersuchen komplexe wirtschaftliche, digitale und sicherheitsrelevante Sachverhalte, analysieren internationale Netzwerke und schaffen belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Unternehmen, Finanzinstitutionen, Rechtsanwaltskanzleien und institutionelle Entscheidungsträger. Für unsere Intelligence Operations suchen wir einen Intelligence Specialist, der analytisches Denken, technisches Verständnis und nachrichtendienstliche Neugier miteinander verbindet. Aufgaben Eigenständige Durchführung nationaler und internationaler Intelligence Investigations. Systematische Informationsbeschaffung mittels Open Source Intelligence (OSINT). Durchführung von Social Media Intelligence (SOCMINT) und Analyse digitaler Identitäten. Identifikation, Analyse und Visualisierung komplexer Personen-, Unternehmens- und Organisationsnetzwerke. Untersuchung internationaler Unternehmensstrukturen, Beteiligungsverhältnisse und wirtschaftlicher Verflechtungen. Analyse digitaler Spuren, öffentlich zugänglicher Datenbestände und digitaler Infrastrukturen. Identifikation und Analyse von Desinformation, Fake-Profilen und koordinierten digitalen Aktivitäten. Informationsbeschaffung im Surface Web, Deep Web und in rechtmässig zugänglichen Bereichen des Darknets. Mitarbeit an komplexen Mandaten in den Bereichen Wirtschaftskriminalität, Betrug, Asset Tracing und Due Diligence. Durchführung von Financial Intelligence (FININT) und Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT) Analysen. Strukturierung, Aufbereitung und Verknüpfung grosser Informationsbestände. Quellenbewertung, Informationsverifizierung und Entwicklung analytischer Hypothesen. Erstellung professioneller Intelligence Reports, Dossiers und Lagebilder. Entwicklung neuer nachrichtendienstlicher Recherche- und Analysemethoden. Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung proprietärer FOREUS Intelligence-Technologien. Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Intelligence Specialists, Ermittlern und Technologieexperten. Qualifikation Wir suchen keine klassischen Recherchemitarbeiter. Wir suchen Menschen, die unkonventionell denken, komplexe Zusammenhänge erkennen und sich nicht mit oberflächlichen Antworten zufriedengeben. Berufserfahrung im Bereich Intelligence, OSINT, digitale Ermittlungen oder vergleichbaren Tätigkeitsfeldern. Fundierte Kenntnisse digitaler Informationsbeschaffungs- und Analysemethoden. Ausgeprägtes analytisches, logisches und vernetztes Denkvermögen. Technisches Verständnis digitaler Plattformen, Datenbanken und Informationssysteme. Erfahrung im Umgang mit professionellen Recherche- und Analysewerkzeugen. Fähigkeit, komplexe und widersprüchliche Informationen kritisch zu bewerten. Strukturierte, präzise und nachvollziehbare Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit und professionelle Berichterstattung. Verständnis rechtlicher und datenschutzrechtlicher Rahmenbedingungen der Informationsbeschaffung. Ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative, Belastbarkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Absolute Diskretion und persönliche Integrität. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Weitere Fremdsprachen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Besonders interessant sind für uns Kenntnisse in folgenden Bereichen: Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) Social Media Intelligence (SOCMINT) Financial Intelligence (FININT) Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT) Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Digital Forensics Blockchain Intelligence Dark Web Intelligence Corporate Investigations Link Analysis & Network Mapping Data Mining & Data Analysis Artificial Intelligence Research Automation Ein akademischer Abschluss ist für uns nicht zwingend erforderlich. Entscheidend sind deine tatsächlichen Fähigkeiten, deine analytische Kompetenz und die Qualität deiner Arbeit. Bewerbungen von ehemaligen Mitarbeitern staatlicher Nachrichtendienste, Sicherheitsbehörden und militärischer Nachrichteneinheiten sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Benefits Mitarbeit an komplexen nationalen und internationalen Intelligence-Mandaten. Zugang zu proprietären Intelligence-Technologien und professionellen Analysewerkzeugen. Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Experten aus Nachrichtendienst, Sicherheit, Wirtschaft und Technologie. Aktive Mitgestaltung neuer Intelligence-Methoden und technologischer Lösungen. Kontinuierliche fachliche Weiterentwicklung und individuelle Spezialisierung. Internationale Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der FOREUS Group. Hohe Eigenverantwortung und analytischer Gestaltungsspielraum. Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine leistungsorientierte Unternehmenskultur. Attraktive, qualifikations- und leistungsabhängige Vergütung. Think beyond the obvious. Intelligence ist keine gewöhnliche berufliche Tätigkeit. Es ist eine Art zu denken, Informationen zu hinterfragen, Muster zu erkennen und Unsicherheit in belastbare Erkenntnisse zu verwandeln. Wir suchen Menschen, die dort weiterdenken, wo andere aufhören. Menschen, die nicht nur wissen wollen, was passiert ist, sondern auch verstehen wollen, warum es passiert ist und welche Zusammenhänge dahinterstehen. Wenn du bereit bist, deine Fähigkeiten in einem international ausgerichteten Private Intelligence Unternehmen einzusetzen und die Zukunft dieser Branche aktiv mitzugestalten, dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As part of Wolt’s Platform department (Core Group), you’ll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization.&nbsp;</p> <p>As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you’ll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot &amp; Cold storage management and more.</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>You’ll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience:</p> <ul> <li>A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users.</li> <li>Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems.</li> <li>A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently.</li> <li>Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change.</li> <li>A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.</li> <li>A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.</li> </ul> <h3>Technical proficiencies:</h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.</li> <li>Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of Kubernetes, including EKS, as an end user.</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to tick every box, but if you see yourself in many of these points, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h2><strong><br></strong>What we offer</h2> <p>At Wolt, we’re committed to building an environment where engineers can make an impact while enjoying meaningful challenges. As a member of the the team you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Working on solutions that support millions of users</li> <li>Solving complex problems in performance, reliability and automation</li> <li>A collaborative and inclusive culture that supports your professional and personal well-being</li> </ul> <p>We also offer flexible work arrangements, competitive compensation, and ongoing learning opportunities to help you thrive.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.</p></div><p>We’re looking for a Field Application Engineer who’s wired for AI/ML, fluent in real-world problem-solving, and excited to build with the people actually using what we make. You will collaborate closely with the sales team and enterprise customers, leveraging your deep technical knowledge in AI to drive the adoption of our products and solutions. title: Senior Software Engineer, Cluster & Lifecycle (EMEA)
description: Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations. Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data. As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI. The Team and Your Impact Qdrant Cloud is growing fast, and most of the new product features on our 2027 roadmap land with this team. That means a lot of new work: cross-region replication, disaster recovery and new ways to manage clusters. This role is for engineers who like hard distributed systems problems, write Go every day, and want their code to manage real customer databases in production. What You Will Own Design and build features in our Kubernetes operator and control-plane services, in Go. Own the full cluster lifecycle: provisioning, scaling, upgrades, configuration changes, backups and restores. Design APIs and integrations that let people, and more and more AI agents, manage Qdrant Cloud. Close the feature gaps between Hybrid Cloud and our managed cloud, and extend Private Cloud. Make cluster operations safe by default: controlled rollouts, minimal disruption to customers and clear failure handling. Take part in on-call for the services you build, including incident response and root cause analysis. Work closely with other teams (Operations, Platform, and Billing & IAM teams, Product and Support). Who you are 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a good part of it on infrastructure, platform or distributed systems. Strong proficiency in Go. Experience building Kubernetes operators, controllers or similar orchestration services (reconciliation loops, retries, recovering from partial failures). Strong understanding of distributed systems: consistency, failure handling, replication. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP or Azure). Experience designing APIs (gRPC or REST) and with CI/CD and automated testing. Comfortable participating in on-call rotations and handling production incidents. Ownership mindset and clear communication skills. Nice to have Experience running stateful workloads or databases on Kubernetes. Background in database, storage or DBaaS products. Experience with backup, replication or disaster recovery systems. Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or similar tooling. Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Kubernetes ecosystem. Why join us A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure. A competitive salary with additional perks. Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture. High ownership and real impact. Open-source, engineering-driven culture. Choose your own laptop equipment. For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy. Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. title: Team Lead Data Science – Pricing & Forecasting (m/f/x)
description: We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to join our Data department and lead the Data Science team behind rebuy’s dynamic pricing: the people and the roadmap for the forecasting and price elasticity models that steer our high-stakes commercial decisions. At rebuy, data science isn’t a side project. The models your team builds ship to production and directly shape what we buy, what we sell and at what price. We care about outcomes, not just predictions, and we’re looking for someone who connects commercial priorities with technical execution. You are a player-coach: you lead from inside the work. Sometimes that means unblocking your team, aligning requirements with Commercial or translating business strategy into clear technical deliverables. Sometimes it means reviewing an architecture, pairing on a tricky modeling problem or shipping code yourself. You set the priorities and the pace, make sure the team’s work reaches production, and keep the quality bar high across our models and pipelines. Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste. Our team of 500 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet. Key Responsibilities: Lead and grow your team: Manage, mentor and coach a focused team of Senior Data Scientists through regular 1:1s, clear performance expectations and support for their career growth. Build a culture where impact counts more than model accuracy alone Own the roadmap: Work with Commercial and Data leadership to turn commercial goals into an actionable data science roadmap. Own prioritization, capacity planning and sprint execution, and make the call when not everything fits Stay hands-on: Keep engineering and modeling standards high. Take part in architecture design, code reviews, feature research and modeling work alongside your team, and keep shipping code yourself Make sure it works in reality: Design and run A/B tests for new launches, and make sure forecasting models get rigorous offline validation and backtesting before they go live Bridge business and tech: Translate commercial needs into technical requirements and technical trade-offs into business language. raw.title: Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
raw.description:
Wir öffnen eine neue, zentrale Position in unserem Team: eine Person, die Recruiting nicht als Aufgabe, sondern als Handwerk und Hebel für Unternehmenserfolg versteht. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Besetzung von Rollen über alle Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg – von Fachexpert:innen bis Führungspositionen – und gestaltest gleichzeitig aktiv mit, wie Talent Acquisition bei uns strukturell und strategisch weiterwächst.

Wir suchen jemanden, der im Recruiting bereits angekommen ist - mit fundierter Praxis, einem klaren Verständnis für die Mechanik guter Prozesse und dem Ehrgeiz, den Bereich aktiv mitzuprägen. Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen operativer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick, zwischen Tempo und Präzision, zwischen Beratung und klarer Kante gegenüber Stakeholdern bis auf C-Level.

Recruiting bei uns ist kein ruhiges Gewässer. Es ist schnell, anspruchsvoll und ergebnisorientiert. Genau das soll dich reizen, nicht abschrecken.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

Operative Exzellenz

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess über alle Funktionen und Level, mit strukturierter, kompetenzbasierter Interviewführung mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Fairness

  • Sparringspartner:in für Hiring Manager, Leadership und C-Level, von der Anforderungsschärfung bis zur finalen Entscheidung

  • Steuerung mehrerer kritischer Suchen parallel, mit transparenter Kommunikation an Stakeholder und Kandidat:innen und einer Candidate Experience, die auch unter Zeitdruck überzeugt

  • Aktives Sourcing, gezielte Marktbearbeitung und Aufbau strategischer Talent Pools für wiederkehrend gefragte Profile

Planung, Reporting und Steuerung

  • Austausch mit den Hiring Manager:innen über den Bedarf, aktuell rund 30 Hires im kommenden Jahr inklusive Replacements

  • Steuerung des Budgets für Stellenanzeigen und Optimierung der Kanäle nach Performance 

  • Definition von Recruiting-KPIs, Steigerung der Funnel-Conversion und konsequentes Nachschärfen bei Engpässen

  • Regelmäßiges Reporting der Recruiting-Kennzahlen insbesondere für Business Reviews

Strategische Weiterentwicklung von TA

  • Weiterentwicklung von Talent Acquisition in enger Abstimmung mit dem Head of People & Culture, strukturell, prozessual und strategisch

  • Entwicklung von Active-Search-Strategien und Aufbau externer Partnerschaften für ein schlagkräftigeres Recruiting

  • Verantwortung für Recruiting-Tools und -Systeme, von der Auswahl bis zur Optimierung, mit sauberen, verlässlichen Recruiting-Daten und definierten Prozessstandards

  • Kontinuierliche Prozessweiterentwicklung, inklusive Prüfung des sinnvollen Einsatzes von KI im Recruiting

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige, nachweisbare Recruiting-Praxis, idealerweise über mehrere Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg, inklusive Steuerung kompletter Recruiting-Prozesse und der Tool-Landschaft

  • Erfahrung im Austausch mit Hiring Manager:innen über Bedarfe und im Reporting gegenüber Senior Stakeholdern

  • Ein fundiertes Verständnis für strukturierte, datenbasierte Prozesse und Active Sourcing

  • Analytisches Denken für Funnel, Kennzahlen und Prozessqualität

  • Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit Senior Stakeholdern bis zur Geschäftsführung

  • Souveränität, Verhandlungsgeschick und den Mut, auch unbequeme Empfehlungen klar und respektvoll auszusprechen

  • Die Fähigkeit, operativ tief einzusteigen und gleichzeitig strategisch den Überblick zu behalten

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise

About the role

The Technical Account Manager owns the day-to-day operational relationship with operator and aggregator clients from go-live onward. They give each client a single technical contact who knows their setup, freeing Account Management to focus on commercial growth. They are accountable for the quality of client configurations and for making changes quickly and accurately, within the standards set by Operations and Compliance, escalating any exceptions.

This is not a commercial, first-line support or approval role: the TAM carries no revenue target, handles complex and recurring tickets rather than all of them, and follows published configuration standards rather than setting them.

Responsibilities

Client ownership after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical and operational contact for newly onboarded clients.
  • Act as the main stakeholder on integration channels after go-live, picking up operational requests and routing anything commercial to the Account Manager.
  • Monitor the period after go-live for latency and early signs of problems that would affect a successful launch, and escalate before the client reports them.
  • Manage key accounts from an operational perspective, supporting clients through changes to their setup.

Operational configuration and change

  • Own financial limit changes and RTP updates, applying the current Booming standards and escalating any request that falls outside them.
  • Own tournament configuration where this sits with Customer Success rather than with the Account Manager.
  • Handle general client requests such as media files and thumbnails, which clients may now request directly from the TAM.
  • Handle setup changes: new currencies, new configurations, account migrations and account splits.

Issue resolution and escalation

  • Handle daily operational queries and lead the resolution of higher complexity issues across Operations, Platform and SRE.
  • Keep the client informed in plain language during an incident, with content routed through the agreed communication channel.
  • Translate operator needs into clear, prioritised internal requests that an engineer can act on without a second conversation.

Process and improvement

  • Monitor internal operational processes: ticket flow, SLAs, escalation paths and release communication.
  • Identify recurring issues and gaps, propose improvements, and implement the ones that are agreed.
  • Keep the client-facing operational documentation current for the accounts in scope.

Requirements

Experience

  • 3+ years in a technical account management, technical support or operations role in B2B software, ideally iGaming or another integration-heavy environment.
  • Experience owning client relationships after go-live, including incident communication to a demanding counterparty.
  • Experience working to SLAs and defending them internally.

Technical

  • Comfortable with APIs, integration patterns and reading logs well enough to triage before escalating.
  • Able to work in a ticketing and documentation stack (Jira, Confluence) and in internal configuration tooling.
  • Able to read and sanity-check configuration data: game options, limits, currencies, jurisdiction settings.
  • SQL or equivalent query ability is an advantage, for checking a claim before raising it.

Communication

  • Writes clearly under pressure, in a way that does not create commitments the company has not made.
  • Holds a position with a client when the answer is no, and escalates rather than improvising an exception.
  • Works across Account Management, Operations, Platform and Compliance without owning any of them.

Nice to have

  • iGaming operator or aggregator integration experience.
  • Familiarity with regulated market configuration differences across jurisdictions.
  • Experience improving a support or operations process and measuring the result.

Good to know

What does success in the first 6 months looks like:

  • Named operator accounts have a single technical contact and a documented, current setup.
  • Operational request volume reaching Account Managers drops measurably against the current baseline.
  • Complex issues are resolved inside SLA, with recurring causes identified and at least two fixed at source.
  • Configuration changes are executed without a compliance or limit error.
  • Clients hear about launch-affecting issues from the TAM before they raise them.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2> <p>As Fin becomes mission-critical for our most strategic customers, we’re growing our team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bridge the gap between customer needs and product innovation. This is a hybrid role, based in either our London or Dublin office.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with strategic customers, partnering closely with our R&amp;D and Go-to-Market teams to design and deliver high-impact solutions. You’ll go beyond implementation - helping shape product direction, influence roadmap decisions and ensure Fin delivers real, measurable business outcomes in complex, real-world environments.</p> <p>If you’re excited by ownership, creativity and solving ambiguous problems, and want to work at the frontier of applied AI while collaborating with Product, Engineering and Go-to-Market teams, this role offers a rare opportunity to combine technical excellence with real customer impact.</p> <h2>What will I be doing?&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>Drive adoption of Fin by helping customers unlock the power of our AI capabilities to automate and scale their support operations.</li> <li>Embed deeply with strategic customers to understand their business challenges and technical requirements, and provide the insight needed to achieve outstanding results with Fin.</li> <li>Work hands-on with customers’ technical teams as a trusted technical expert, coding side-by-side to drive projects through to completion.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Sales, Success and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, successful project delivery and actionable product feedback.</li> <li>Contribute to the evolution of Forward Deployed Engineering by codifying best practices and sharing insights from customer engagements to help the team scale and grow.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>A strong engineering background and experience building software with real-world usage. Experience building a SaaS product is a plus, but not a requirement.</li> <li>Interest in AI and machine learning, and the ability to quickly build an understanding of novel problems, capabilities and architectures - including their trade-offs and limitations.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate organisational boundaries and bring people together to achieve the best outcomes for our customers.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of at least one high-level programming language, such as JavaScript, Python or Ruby. It doesn’t need to be a language we use today - great people learn quickly and can introduce us to better ways of working.</li> <li>The ability to prototype and ship software quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality and a clear focus on business goals and outcomes.</li> <li>Proficiency using and writing REST APIs to integrate systems effectively.</li> <li>Strong communication skills. You can comfortably discuss the same topics with engineers and non-technical audiences, adapting the depth and detail as needed.</li> <li>Willingness to travel and work on-site with customers to build strong relationships and deeply understand their needs.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData and our Trillion Gene Atlas (TGA), the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role

We're seeking a Head of Security to join our team in London and own the security of Basecamp Research: our data, our models, our locations and our people.

We hold one of the most valuable proprietary biological datasets in the world and the models trained on it, and we operate labs, field expeditions and partnerships across more than 30 countries. Our proprietary data and IP is incredibly powerful therefore we have a duty to our investors, employees, governments and partners to do everything in our power to protect it and use it for positive outcomes. Our security function will take the lead on cyber security and AI safety, and we have strong technical controls across our estate, working with governmental and commercial partners. We now need a new leader to build on our security foundations and develop them into a complete, mature security programme.

This is a hands-on role with a wide remit: cyber and infrastructure security with the platform team, AI and agentic security across the company, and personnel, insider risk, physical and travel security with the People and Operations teams

  • Hands-on. You will personally run vulnerability management, review infrastructure designs, lead incident and crisis response and write policy.

Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform. What you'll be working on: Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services. Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries. Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles. Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal. Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models. Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production. Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services. Driving architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and mentoring other engineers. Leveraging AI extensively but responsibly, including developing guardrails, agent harnesses, and tooling to maintain engineering quality in a fast-paced environment. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Product Designer
description: About Zable Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money . Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021 The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices. The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more. Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting We're looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Zable. You'll join a team of 5 product designers and report to the VP of Product & Design. You'll work mainly on the Zable app, our financial SuperApp with 2M+ monthly active users. It brings together credit cards, loans, memberships, mobile and more in one place. You'll own complex product areas end-to-end, from discovery and research through to polished, production-ready design. You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team. The ideal candidate 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup Strong mobile app and web experience Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback Bonus: Designing AI-powered products (explainability, human override) Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty UX writing What you'll be doing Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work Run design critiques and write rationale that stands on its own Our design principles Simplicity wins If a user has to think too hard, we’ve already lost. We strip away complexity, jargon, and unnecessary steps to make managing finances effortless. Every screen should feel intuitive, focused, and frictionless. Evidence over ego We don’t design based on opinions. Everything we build is informed by data, tested, and refined based on real user behavior. Trust is our best feature Finance is built on trust. Every design decision should reinforce transparency, security, and user confidence. We prove we care by helping users make financial decisions that empower them. The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people.
