raw.description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

 

About the Role

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

 

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-depth discovery and implementation sessions for your book of business, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

  • Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

  • Design and drive AI Agent adoption roadmaps for each customer, sequencing automation rollout to support change management and prove value at each stage.

  • Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to value through a white-glove experience, providing expert guidance on both Helpdesk and AI Agent configuration.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience.

  • Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI Agent, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly. Proactively uses tools like Claude to improve your own efficiency.

  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

  • Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption, and mitigating churn.

  • Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth. You stay current on Gorgias product developments and ecommerce trends, and you actively contribute to team knowledge.

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

title: Senior Engineering Team Lead
description: WHO WE ARE Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.  Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees. Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay. WHAT YOU WILL DO We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills. You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users. As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team. Engineering: Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure. Architect, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the rigorous demands of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence workflows. Make sure data is always available and reliable: oversee processing, storage, aggregation, transformation, and API development. Streamline our data processes by integrating efficient testing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and error recovery. Design and implement robust data models and transformation pipelines that make reporting data easy to discover, understand, and use. Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence. Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions. Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity. Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution. Management : Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work. Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals. Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments. Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members. Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills. Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards. Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. WHO YOU ARE You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas: Experience : Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter. Data Volume : Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements. Technical Stack : Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus. Coding Skills : You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus. Data Modeling : Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus. Data Transformation : Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus. Engineering Leadership : Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level. People Management : Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team. Communication : Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level. Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position. COMPENSATION Competitive Salary between 100,000 and 120,000€ OTE We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. PERKS AND BENEFITS 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off); Longevity bonus every 2 years; Profit-sharing scheme Healthcare plan with excellent coverage; Lunch Vouchers; Mental Health support; Flexible remote working policy; Regular team-life event / activity; Inclusive parental leave Policy. *Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are.  OUR PROCESS What to expect as you move through our hiring process: HR call with Maxime, Team Lead - Talent Acquisition, Technical interview with Youcef, Senior Engineering Team Lead, & Adrian, Senior Data Engineer Team fit interview with Aldenis, VP Engineering,  A final interview with Cédric, Chief Technology Officer and Loïc, Chief Product Officer.  If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team. OUR COMMITMENT We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future. Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status. raw.title: Full-stack Developer
raw.description:
As a leading ad tech company, we help publishers thrive in an increasingly challenging and complex digital world dominated by GAFAs.

Our unique AI-based SaaS platform offers a range of products that help publishers optimize their revenue and operational efficiency.

Over 100 prestigious customers in 20 countries, including industry leaders such as Microsoft, Dotdash Meredith, and Tripadvisor, use our solutions daily.

Tasks

Are you a full-stack developer who loves delivering features from end to end?

Would you like to work in a start-up environment for the leader in Adtech analytics, using cutting-edge tools like Claude Code to accelerate your workflow?

If you enjoy working on problems involving large amounts of data, are curious, passionate, and care about delivering quality user experiences, join our team of talented developers.

As part of the BUILD team, you'll be responsible for developing features across our products' full stack — from API design to user interface — with complete autonomy.

No more silos: you own your features from start to finish.

You will participate in technical design workshops, propose improvements, and work closely with the Product team daily, as well as with our data engineers and data scientists.

Mission

  • Deliver end-to-end features, from API design (Ruby on Rails) to user interface implementation (React), ensuring a seamless user experience.

  • Collaborate closely with the Product team to understand requirements, propose solutions, and iterate on feedback.

  • Optimize existing application code to improve performance and maintainability.

  • Take the initiative to improve our architecture, design, and development workflows.

Our stack

  • 200+ AWS instances (EC2, S3, SQS, Cognito)

  • 10 TB+ of data ingested every day

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails, Grape API, Sidekiq, Python, Scala

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

  • Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, Redis, Elasticache

  • Testing: RSpec, Jest, Cypress

  • DevOps: Git, GitHub, GitHub A

Requirements

Core Skills

AI-Assisted Development

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar): code generation, refactoring, debugging, and codebase exploration. Ability to craft effective prompts and leverage AI tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality.

Backend (Ruby on Rails)

  • Design, development, and maintenance of Ruby on Rails applications and RESTful APIs (including Grape). Strong focus on clean architecture, scalable patterns, performance, and performance.

  • Experience with testing (RSpec), code reviews, continuous integration, and technical documentation.

Frontend (React)

  • Development of modern web interfaces in React with TypeScript and JSX. Experience with state management (Redux, Zustand) and component-driven architecture. Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and component libraries such as shadcn/ui. Strong UX sensitivity and attention to user experience.

  • Experience setting up and maintaining tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress), and contributing to long-term maintainability

Data & Storage

  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing complex analytical queries. Familiarity with Snowflake is a plus but not required. Experience with environments mixing SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB/Mongoid), and performance/caching tools such as Redis and Elasticache.

Quality & Delivery

  • Strong engineering discipline: automation and tooling with GitHub, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), testing, linting (ESLint), and structured review processes. Experience working with cloud and scalable environments (AWS).

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails and React with TypeScript.

  • You're pragmatic and autonomous, able to take a feature from design to production.

  • You have strong SQL skills and experience with complex analytical queries (Snowflake is a plus)

  • You're comfortable working with REST APIs and distributed systems

  • You embrace modern development practices: testing, code reviews, CI/CD

  • You have strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with Product teams

  • You care about user experience and pay attention to detail

  • You are fluent in English. Proficiency in French is an asset

  • You are based in the CET/CEST timezone ± 2h (for team collaboration)

Benefits

  • Full remote

  • Macbook provide

Ready to join us?

If you're passionate about building quality software, excited about leveraging AI tools to boost your productivity, and want to work with a talented team on challenging ad tech problems, we'd love to hear from you!

At Adomik, we embrace modern development practices – including AI-assisted coding with tools like Claude Code – to help our developers focus on what matters most: solving complex problems and delivering value to our users.

Our recruitment process:

  • Technical assessment (coding challenge)

  • Team interviews (2)

  • Final discussion and offer

The process takes a few weeks. Apply now with your CV – we're looking forward to meeting you!

Contexte de la mission

ImaginePartners recherche un Product Owner Open Source pour accompagner un acteur du secteur ferroviaire dans l’ouverture d’un logiciel de signalisation. Vous piloterez la préparation de l’ouverture et construirez une feuille de route commune aux versions interne et open source. Si la tranche optionnelle est activée, vous assurerez le suivi produit des contributions externes et des publications.

Vos missions

Préparer l’ouverture du logiciel

  • Définir la vision produit, les usages cibles et les jalons d’ouverture. Construire une feuille de route qui articule les évolutions des versions interne et open source.

  • Structurer et prioriser le backlog GitLab. Rédiger les besoins, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation, puis participer aux cycles agiles.

  • Définir avec les équipes techniques le périmètre du code et de la documentation à publier. Coordonner les validations juridiques, de confidentialité et de sécurité.

  • Proposer la gouvernance et le circuit de contribution, puis préparer le dossier de candidature auprès d’OpenRail.

  • Coordonner les équipes métier, les équipes techniques et les partenaires. Suivre l’avancement, les risques et les décisions à soumettre au comité de pilotage.

Suivre les contributions et les publications si l’option est activée

  • Qualifier les contributions externes, échanger avec les contributeurs et coordonner les revues avec les mainteneurs.

  • Préparer les versions publiques et leurs notes de version, tenir à jour la feuille de route publique et animer les échanges avec la communauté.

  • Suivre les écarts entre les deux versions du logiciel et coordonner l’analyse de leurs impacts sur les exigences, les essais et la qualification.

Livrables attendus

  • Note de cadrage et plan de montée en compétence.

  • Cartographie des composants et documents à publier, à conserver en interne ou à exclure, et registre des validations.

  • Feuille de route consolidée, plan d’ouverture et backlog GitLab priorisé.

  • Gouvernance des contributions, matrice des responsabilités, dossier OpenRail et guide de contribution.

  • Dossier de préparation à l’ouverture, supports de pilotage et dossier de passation.

  • Si l’option est activée, registre des contributions, notes de version et bilan communautaire.

Profil recherché

Compétences attendues

  • Expérience de Product Owner sur un produit logiciel, avec pratique du cadrage, de la priorisation et du pilotage d’une feuille de route.

  • Expérience concrète de mise en open source d’un logiciel ou de gouvernance d’un projet open source avec des mainteneurs et des contributeurs externes.

  • Pratique de GitLab ou d’un outil équivalent pour suivre les demandes et les contributions.

  • Capacité à coordonner des interlocuteurs métier, techniques, juridiques et sécurité, et à préparer des arbitrages documentés.

Atouts

  • Expérience du ferroviaire ou d’un environnement soumis à des exigences de qualification logicielle.

  • Expérience de coordination des publications et d’animation d’une communauté open source.

Candidature

  • Votre TJM HT.

  • Votre localisation.

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech?&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Throughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>-&nbsp;Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong></li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships.</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.</li> <li><strong>Work with other innovators.&nbsp;</strong>Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career.&nbsp;</strong>Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>When are you joining?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Fall Edition 2026<br></strong>Start dates: September, October<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Spring Edition 2027<br></strong>Start dates: February, March<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <p>📍 Location: Full-time in Paris, with period trips to NL and DE<br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;">There is no </span><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">deadline</span>:</strong> Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks</strong></h2> <p><strong>🚲Health and Transportation</strong><br>Through our partnerships with Malakoff Humanis and OpenUp, you have the opportunity to enroll in our company health insurance plan, as well as free and easy access to professional psychologists, workshops, and practical tools. Additionally, if you commute to work using public transportation, we reimburse 50% of your subscription cost.</p> <p><strong>🍉Food</strong><br>Since we are located in the center of Paris, there is no on-site cafeteria. However, you will receive meal vouchers worth €11 per day to explore all the delicious restaurants nearby. Our small kitchen is also stocked with tasty snacks and refreshments.</p> <p><strong>📈Personal and Professional Development</strong><br>You will have the opportunity to develop your skills not only through exciting projects and a dynamic environment but also via training programs offered by Lepaya.</p> <p><strong>🏖️All the rest</strong><br>You get 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional rest days (RTT) based on the number of days worked in the year. Picnic provides you with a laptop, a phone, and a paid SIM card.<br>🚀Access to exclusive deals and perks through our Works Council (CSE) and our partner Swile (gift cards, concert tickets, cinema discounts, and more)</p> <h3><strong>FAQ</strong></h3> <p><strong>Do I need a quantitative background? </strong>It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.</p> <p><strong>Does the program include rotations?</strong> No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.</p> <p><strong>In what language should I apply?</strong> English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)</p> <p><strong>What are the long-term opportunities after the program? </strong>This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover.&nbsp;</p> <p>Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.<br><br><br></p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/yEQXLpeYN84?si=It-z9-XNLVMDeHEy" width="560" height="315"></iframe></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Support Specialist - CDI
description: Rejoignez l’aventure Joivy : L’art de vivre (et de travailler) à l’européenne ! Joivy est bien plus qu’une plateforme immobilière : c’est le premier écosystème résidentiel d’Europe conçu pour accompagner chaque étape de la vie. Du coliving au design soigné aux escapades en location de vacances, en passant par le logement étudiant ou des espaces de coworking inspirants, nous créons des lieux où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi. Un écosystème innovant pour tous les besoins Joivy est l’alliance stratégique de pionniers tels que DoveVivo, Altido, Chez-Nestor et Open . Ensemble, nous redéfinissons les codes du marché : Pour nos résidents : Une offre flexible (colocations, studios, villas) pour des séjours de toutes durées, portée par une expérience numérique fluide. Pour nos partenaires : Un accompagnement premium pour les propriétaires et investisseurs, de la gestion d'actifs à la transformation immobilière grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et des outils d'analyse de pointe. L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés : Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans). Une présence XXL : 50 destinations à travers 7 pays (Italie, Espagne, France, Portugal, UK, Luxembourg et Bulgarie). Une force de frappe globale : Près de 2 000 propriétaires accompagnés et plus de 150 000 utilisateurs conquis. Au sein de l'équipe Customer Care (Service Client), votre objectif est de maximiser la satisfaction client. Vous êtes le point de contact principal des clients tout au long de leur parcours, depuis le jour de leur réservation jusqu'au remboursement de leur dépôt de garantie après leur départ. Vous assistez les clients pour l'ensemble de leurs problématiques, qu'elles soient administratives ou financières, y compris pour la maintenance de leur appartement. La maîtrise des langues est essentielle, car une part importante de nos clients est internationale. La majorité de l'équipe est basée à Lyon, à l'exception d'une personne basée à Paris, et nous opérons à distance sur l'ensemble de nos villes en France. Vos missions : Gérer la relation et accompagner le client à distance via Zendesk tout au long de son expérience de coliving, de l'entrée à la sortie du logement : rédaction du bail, vérification des documents, organisation des états des lieux d'entrée ( check-in ) et de sortie ( check-out ), comparaison des états des lieux, remboursement des dépôts de garantie. Créer le dossier client numérique et le mettre à jour tout au long de son parcours. Gérer à distance les conflits entre colivers (colocataires) et les litiges clients, dans le meilleur intérêt de l'entreprise et du client. Recouvrer les impayés de loyers et les différents frais auprès des clients par e-mail et par téléphone. Résoudre les problèmes techniques (paiement, accès au compte client, etc.) rencontrés par le client en mobilisant les ressources de l'entreprise. Qualifier, transmettre et suivre en interne l'exécution des interventions techniques dans les appartements, et en informer le client. Assurer le suivi auprès des locataires concernant les interventions en cours ou à venir. Qualifier et répondre aux différents besoins et demandes des clients par e-mail, chat ou WhatsApp, dans les délais définis par l'entreprise. Contribuer à l'amélioration des pratiques et processus de Customer Happiness afin d'accroître la satisfaction client et d'optimiser les coûts opérationnels des logements en coliving : remonter les bugs à l'équipe technique, améliorer les flux de travail ( workflows ), numériser les processus, etc. Ton profil se distingue par : Diplômé(e) en gestion, commerce ou relations clients, tu justifies idéalement d'une première expérience réussie dans le secteur immobilier (gestion locative, transaction ou property management). Tu es un(e) communicant(e) hors pair. Tu sais allier empathie, clarté et fermeté pour instaurer un climat de confiance tout en défendant les intérêts de Joivy et de ses partenaires. Véritable "digital native", tu maîtrises les outils collaboratifs modernes (type Zendesk, CRM) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les modes de travail hybrides ou à distance. Tu ne te contentes pas de gérer l'existant. Ta proactivité et ton esprit d'analyse te poussent à identifier des axes d'amélioration et à proposer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser nos processus. Parce que nous savons que nos experts sont notre meilleure ressource, nous vous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant : Intégrez une communauté soudée et ultra-motivée pour relever des défis collectifs ! On ne s'ennuie jamais chez nous ! Entre nos afterwork, nos chasses aux œufs mémorables, ou nos incontournables petits-déjeuners du mardi, la convivialité est sacrée. La mutuelle performante de Swisslife avec de fortes garanties pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. Des tickets restaurant de 9 €/jour (via carte Edenred), prise à 50% du titre de transport. description: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define. What you'll do Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products Requirements Two things matter most: Taste. You have a distinct eye and a strong point of view, and you can build a visual world that looks like nobody else's. Everything you make feels considered, right down to the type. Thinking. You start from the idea. You can take a strategy and a belief and turn them into a system with a reason behind every choice, and you can explain those reasons in plain words to anyone in the company. Beyond that, we want someone with deep craft in typography, colour and composition, who has built or evolved an identity system that went live in the real world, and who moves fast without letting quality slip. We expect you to have 5+ years experience, ideally at a top studio or on an in-house team at a brand people admire. Motion, 3D or packaging experience is a bonus. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define.

What you'll do

  • Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard
  • Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room
  • Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery
  • Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand
  • Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products

Requirements

Two things matter most:

Taste. You have a distinct eye and a strong point of view, and you can build a visual world that looks like nobody else's. Everything you make feels considered, right down to the type.

Thinking. You start from the idea. You can take a strategy and a belief and turn them into a system with a reason behind every choice, and you can explain those reasons in plain words to anyone in the company.

Beyond that, we want someone with deep craft in typography, colour and composition, who has built or evolved an identity system that went live in the real world, and who moves fast without letting quality slip. We expect you to have 5+ years experience, ideally at a top studio or on an in-house team at a brand people admire. Motion, 3D or packaging experience is a bonus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs
  • Private health insurance
  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

title: Senior Country Commercial Manager - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>About the team&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>Tide is the leading business financial platform founded in the UK, empowering over 1 million small businesses to grow and succeed. Now expanding in France, Tide offers innovative financial tools and services to micro-entrepreneurs, freelancers, independent professionals (professions libérales) and small and medium-sized businesses (TPE/PME). Our mission is to save business owners time and money, enabling them to focus on what they do best - running their business.</p> <p>You’ll be joining a dedicated and dynamic team in Paris focused on driving Tide’s market success in France. The Tide France team is in an exciting growth phase, bringing together professionals with deep expertise in fintech, product development and French market dynamics. As part of this expanding team, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape Tide’s presence in France, working collaboratively to deliver innovative solutions for French small business owners. This is your chance to play a pivotal role in establishing the foundation for our long-term success in this key market.</p> <h2><strong>About the role&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking an exceptional <strong>Senior</strong> <strong>Country Commercial Manager</strong>, based in Paris, to drive the growth of Tide’s business accounts and payment solutions in France. In this pivotal role, you will lead product growth initiatives, leveraging analytics, customer insights, and market trends to position Tide as a leading financial partner for small businesses in France.</p> <p>As the Senior Country Commercial Manager, you will have accountability for French revenues, working closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams. Develop and execute strategies to meet revenue targets, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between product offerings, pricing, and go-to-market initiatives.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Local Market Expertise: </strong>Collaborate with the product research teams to conduct French market research to uncover customer needs, analyse a competitive landscape of neobanks and traditional banks, and identify market opportunities, such as the e-invoicing mandate (facturation électronique) rolling out from September 2026. Translate these insights into actionable strategies to enhance Tide’s product offerings.</li> <li><strong>Product Localization and Development: </strong>Collaborate with global product managers to design and launch products tailored to the French market, reflecting local payment habits, invoicing and accounting workflows. Lead initiatives to ensure local relevance and compliance with French and EU requirements, while maintaining alignment with Tide’s global vision.</li> <li><strong>Marketing and Sales Strategy: </strong>Work with regional marketing teams to<strong> </strong>develop and refine marketing and sales strategies for marketing the products in the French market, including partnerships with key SME channels such as accountants (experts-comptables) and the entrepreneur ecosystem (Bpifrance, CCI, incubators). Monitor performance metrics and adapt plans to ensure we meet and exceed growth targets.</li> <li><strong>Content and Collateral Creation: </strong>Support creation of high-quality marketing and customer-facing materials in French, ensuring they comply with French regulations (including ACPR rules on commercial practices) and resonate with local audiences.</li> <li><strong>Operational Readiness and Go-Live Support: </strong>Partner with the Operations team to ensure seamless product launches, from final QA testing to internal training and ongoing support for new features.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong>: Act as the central point of contact between Tide’s global teams and the Paris team, driving alignment and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have 7+ years' relevant experience ideally within the SME, SaaS, or fintech industries in France. Experience with banking or payment solutions for French SMEs is highly desirable.</li> <li>You are fluent in French (native or near-native) and professional English, as you’ll work daily with French customers and partners and with Tide’s global teams.</li> <li>You know the French SME ecosystem well (micro-entrepreneurs, TPE/PME, accountants, banking and payment players) and its regulatory environment.</li> <li>You excel at developing and executing commercial strategies that deliver measurable business impact. You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and remove blockers.</li> <li>You have very strong project management skills and can foster collaboration with teams outside of your direct control by building strong relationships.</li> <li>You’re well versed in product analytics, and can use data to drive decisions within product marketing campaigns and follow it up with actions to constantly improve on product acquisition and engagement&nbsp; goals.</li> <li>You’ve worked across multiple markets, navigating the complexities of global product development with a keen understanding of localization requirements.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving company where priorities can change and processes may need to be created from scratch.</li> <li>You’re a self-starter who doesn’t wait for instruction, and who works backwards from targets to ensure effective execution.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get in return:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>25 days of paid leave per year (congés payés)</li> <li>Additional 3 days of paid leave for volunteering or L&amp;D</li> <li>We invest in your development with a professional L&amp;D budget</li> <li>Complementary health insurance (mutuelle) and disability and life cover (prévoyance)</li> <li>Statutory pension contributions (basic and Agirc-Arrco complementary pension)</li> <li>50% reimbursement of your public transport pass (e.g. Navigo)</li> <li>Extended Parental Leave</li> <li>Mental health support through Plumm</li> <li>A one-off home office budget</li> <li>Work and travel globally - up to 90 days per country outside of your home country</li> <li>Team socials&nbsp;</li> <li>Sabbatical Leave&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Tidean Ways of Working</strong></h2> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices, including our Paris office, are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Judge what to own personally, what to delegate and when to intervene; retain accountability for quality and outcomes.</li> </ul> <p>Coordinate across the business</p> <ul> <li>Work closely with stakeholders across Nebius – GTM country leads, Marketing, Business Diplomacy, Product, Research, Technology, subject experts and other colleagues – to coordinate on issues including regional priorities, policy, local engagement and reputation management.</li> <li>Coordinate with US, APAC and global communications leaders on announcements, issues and executive visibility. Maintain early visibility of consequential developments within appropriate confidentiality controls.</li> </ul> <p><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Key Qualifications and Experience</strong></span><br><br>What we need</p> <ul> <li>A strong record of senior communications leadership in Europe and the Middle East, with substantial in-house technology-company experience and the ability to operate credibly across the region.</li> <li>Outstanding storytelling and narrative-development skills: translating complex business and technology priorities into compelling, credible stories for different audiences and markets.</li> <li>Demonstrated people-management experience: setting goals, coaching, managing performance and developing capable colleagues.</li> <li>Gravitas and senior experience to personally lead high-stakes, multi-stakeholder situations, advise business leaders and navigate competing interests with sound judgment.</li> <li>Evidence of judging when personal involvement is essential and when to delegate, alongside strong media relationships and experience directing agencies and regional resources.</li> <li>Outstanding English writing, editing and spoken communication, with the curiosity and rigor to understand complex technology and build accurate narratives.</li> </ul> <p>Helpful experience</p> <ul> <li>AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology or another complex B2B sector; regional expansion, infrastructure investment or a publicly listed company.</li> <li>Substantial Middle East communications work, relevant media relationships and additional regional language skills.</li> <li>Agency experience is valuable alongside substantial in-house experience; an agency-only background does not meet the role’s requirements. Journalism experience can be beneficial.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies and Behavioural Traits</strong><br><br>Strong narrative judgment, senior presence, clear prioritisation and calm leadership. A capable people manager who develops others, gives direct feedback and delegates with purpose. description: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Backend teams at Trainline 👋 The Backend teams at Trainline build the core of Trainline’s world class product. Leveraging Trainline’s scale and high-intent traveller audience, we deliver native, context-aware ad formats, sponsored journeys, and rewards across our mobile and Web platforms. Our mission is to build a premium, customer-first advertising ecosystem that enriches the passenger journey while driving sustainable commercial growth. As a senior level .NET Engineer at Trainline you will... 🚄 Deliver new functionality or features, using the most appropriate tools & techniques Ensure quality is at the heart of everything you and your team do Continuously improve the code base Keep our customer as the number one priority Actively identify blockers, boulders, time sinks and waste, and actively attempt to remove them Make significant contribution to technical decisions Act as a coach and mentor to others in the team • Take full ownership of the development lifecycle from code to production, including deployment and monitoring Our Tech Stack 🔑 Languages & Frameworks: C# (.NET 6–10) Databases: DynamoDB, PostgreSQL Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Cloud, Docker, Terraform CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions • Monitoring & Logging: New Relic, ELK Stack We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍 Experience mentoring less experienced engineers and comfortable pair-programming with colleagues Hands on experience with C# .NET and the latest features Experience collaborating with front-end engineers and other disciplines to deliver end-to-end features and cross-functional epics Experience working with identity and authentication systems (e.g. IdentityServer, OpenID Connect, OAuth2) Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Spacelift or similar tools) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also valuable) Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform Strong experience with observability practices (logging, monitoring, alerting) Familiarity with tools such as New Relic and ELK stack (or equivalents) Curiosity about AI and emerging tools Experience supporting production systems and improving reliability Strong experience building and operating microservices architectures Experience with event-driven systems and asynchronous messaging patterns Solid understanding of distributed systems and scalability challenges Have excellent communication skills More information: Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. Tu portes le produit de la première expérimentation jusqu'à son déploiement et son adoption. Travailler avec les équipes Data, ML Ops et Tech. Entre le prototype et l'usage réel, il y a la qualité des données, la fiabilité des réponses, les coûts, l'adoption par les équipes et la valeur business à démontrer. C'est là que se joue le métier de PM IA & Data, et c'est là que tu interviens chez Hubvisory.

Tu accompagnes des comptes comme Ledger, Decathlon ou Veolia dans la conception de produits dont le cœur est l'IA ou la donnée. Selon les missions, tu es PM IA (LLM, RAG, agents), PM Data (plateformes, produits data, pilotage par la donnée), ou les deux à la fois. Tu ne te contentes pas de piloter un backlog : tu décides de ce qui doit être construit, de ce qui est réaliste, et de ce qui rapporte.

Tes missions

  • Cadrer les cas d'usage à valeur. Tu traduis des problématiques métier complexes en une roadmap IA ou Data ambitieuse, avec un ROI clair.

  • Arbitrer la faisabilité. Données disponibles, qualité, contraintes techniques, coûts : tu tranches entre ce qui est souhaitable et ce qui est tenable.

  • Piloter du POC à la production. Tu portes le produit de la première expérimentation jusqu'à son déploiement et son adoption.

  • Travailler avec les équipes Data, ML Ops et Tech. Tu comprends leurs contraintes, tu challenges les choix d'architecture et tu parles un langage commun.

  • Mesurer ton impact et défendre tes décisions. Qualité des sorties, adoption, valeur créée : tu définis les indicateurs et tu les portes devant les parties prenantes.

  • Fédérer. Tu rends accessible une technologie complexe à des interlocuteurs exigeants, pour les aligner sur une vision produit claire.

Notre objectif : faire de toi un PM IA & Data de référence, capable de mener des produits intelligents jusqu'à la production, que ce soit sur l'IA, sur la donnée ou sur les deux. Selon ton appétence, ton évolution se construit vers Senior, Product Leader, Manager ou Principal.

Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory

  • Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire.

  • Un pure player du Product, en avance sur l'IA et la Data. Le Product est notre sujet de prédilection, pas une offre parmi d'autres. Nous avons créé notre track IA & Data dès 2024, quand le marché hésitait encore. Tu rejoins une équipe qui a de l'avance, avec des produits IA en production, pas des démonstrations.

  • Une progression alignée sur ton impact. Revalorisations salariales bi-annuelles, passages de grade fondés sur la performance et non sur l'ancienneté.

  • Un onboarding structuré. Un parcours collectif et individuel, avec un plan de formation et une montée en charge progressive. Tu es accompagné par un buddy et un mentor dédiés, et tu as accès à 1000h de contenu à la carte.

  • Une taille humaine. Avec 135+ consultants, chacun est identifié, écouté et accompagné.


Le profil recherché

  • 2 à 5 ans d'expérience comme PM / PO sur des produits digitaux, dont au moins une expérience significative sur un produit IA ou Data. Tu as l'envie et la capacité de couvrir les deux champs. Utiliser l'IA au quotidien ne suffit pas : on attend d'avoir porté un produit et d'avoir pesé sur ses choix techniques.

  • Indispensables : maîtrise de la Discovery et du Delivery, lecture de code (Python / JS), bases solides en SQL, compréhension des APIs (REST / GraphQL) et des architectures LLM / RAG.

  • Atouts : notions de MLOps, outils d'orchestration (LangChain, n8n), expérience en conseil ou en grand groupe produit.

  • Savoir-être : curiosité et esprit critique, capacité à vulgariser, engagement dans le collectif (chez Hubvisory, tu t’engages à la fois chez le client et au sein du cabinet).

  • Anglais courant.

Le process de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un RH : ton projet, notre modèle, tes attentes (45 min)

  2. Cas pratique avec un Manager : hard skills, en live (90 min)

  3. Projection stratégique avec un VP ou un cofondateur : posture et vision (90 min)

  4. Échange de closing avec un RH (15 min)

title: Founding Product Manager - Claap
description: we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO. About Claap Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams. What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work. This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible. Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade. We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM. As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one. You will work with Robin on three big topics: - In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching. - Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app. - Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics. The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing). Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached. Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together. The PM at Claap wears different hats - A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed - A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance - An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe - A diplomat hat to influence your teammates on what we should spend time and effort on, win their trust, and bring visibility, focus, vision and motivation - A builder hat to get your hands dirty with AI, prototype, test and ship, instead of only writing specs about it What you are not - A Project Manager who only talks about methodologies and frameworks - A Product Owner writing super detailed 4-page tickets for devs - A feature factory building every custom request an enterprise prospect asks for - The "Notion docs & meetings person" with no real impact on our users and the business - A "yes man" for every idea and suggestion people bring to you - A people manager looking for a team to run: this role is hands-on Key results Within 3 months you will have - Developed a deep understanding of Claap, the call intelligence market and our product vision - Built relationships with Claap users, from sales reps to the admins of our largest accounts - Mapped the enterprise requirements that slow down or block our deals, and shipped the first ones - Identified the key closing jobs to be done and shipped first iterations with your squad - Won the trust of your squad, Robin, and the Sales and CS teams Within 12 months you will have - Made Claap truly enterprise-ready: governance, settings and configuration are no longer a reason we lose a deal - Made Claap a must-have in our users' closing workflow, with measurable adoption and retention - Positively impacted the company's revenue through solutions you've helped launch - Influenced the Claap product vision by suggesting transformative developments What's in it for you? - A founding role: you're the first PM at Claap, with real ownership on a fast-growing AI product and a direct line to the founders - Helping thousands of sales professionals close more deals - A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action - Opportunity to shape our company's direction - Potential to establish yourself as an expert in AI for sales Preferred experience Must have - You have 5+ years of experience in product. Scale-up experience is highly preferred. - You have a strong academic background (business school, engineering school or equivalent) and/or experience in top-tier companies. - You are a hands-on PM: you are an individual contributor today, or you led product at an early-stage startup. - You have a real taste and curiosity for AI and tech, ideally with features or agents you've launched end to end. - You have a big bias for action: you are a "débrouillard" and understand the value of speed & execution. - You have strong communication skills. - You speak French and English. This is non-negotiable: most of our enterprise accounts are French-speaking. - You have a strong pragmatism. - You have a solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms. - You have a strong business acumen. Nice to have - You have experience in enterprise or upper mid-market SaaS (permissions, admin, SSO, security reviews). - You have worked on sales tech, revenue intelligence or tools used by sales teams. - You have Growth, Revenue Operations or Sales experience. - You know how to wireframe designs. - You are humble and look for clues that you are wrong. - You are curious, always asking questions and learning new stuff. Additional Information - Competitive salary + profit sharing - Where you live and work is totally up to you: we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷 - Profit sharing: when lempire wins, all team members share the profits - Alan Blue: comprehensive 100% premium medical coverage for you and your family - Swile Meal Tickets: daily meal tickets to fuel productivity - Navigo Card: 100% covered Navigo card - Full-remote work setup: a well-funded home office budget - Gear: a laptop + the tools and equipment you need for your job - Team building: we all meet once a year at really cool places around the world Recruitment process - Interview with Victoire, our Talent Acquisition Manager - Interview with Robin, Claap co-founder and CEO - Business Case (async.) + Live Q&A with Robin and Pierre - Team fit - Interview with Charles, our CEO - Reference Check - Offer How to apply Include a short note (200 words max) on an AI feature or agent you shipped end to end. It's the hardest thing to read on a CV, so we screen for it from day one. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Enablement Manager | French Market (Paris)
description: À propos de Lexroom Chez Lexroom , nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café. Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel. Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy. Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ? Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC. Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer. Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne formez pas des commerciaux à vendre un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue. Un impact direct : la qualité de l'équipe commerciale française dépendra de ce que vous construisez. Vos responsabilités Piloter la Lexroom Sales Academy en France : concevoir et animer des programmes de formation récurrents (onboarding, ramp-up, formation avancée), avec objectifs, contenus, calendrier et indicateurs de succès. Gérer l'onboarding des nouvelles recrues commerciales : première semaine et deux premiers mois de ramp-up, en coordonnant agendas, supports, intervenants internes et exercices pratiques. Animer vous-même les modules de formation : méthodologie de vente, discovery, démos, traitement des objections, négociation, gestion du pipeline, avec role-plays, coaching sur les appels et feedback structuré. Maintenir les contenus à jour : playbooks, scripts, templates et supports de l'Academy, en phase avec l'évolution du produit, du marché et des performances de l'équipe. Transformer les succès internes (appels, emails, séquences, deals complexes) en ressources de formation réutilisables. Travailler main dans la main avec les Sales Managers et les AE pour que la formation se traduise concrètement dans le pipeline, les appels et les démos. Aligner l'Academy France avec les initiatives globales et adapter au marché français les best practices déjà éprouvées en Italie. Profil recherché Expérience en management commercial, sales enablement ou gestion de projet en environnement B2B (idéalement SaaS, tech ou conseil). Solide mindset PMO : capacité à transformer des besoins en plans structurés, aligner les parties prenantes, tenir les délais, livrer et mesurer l'impact. À l'aise aussi bien en animation (formations, ateliers, role-plays) que dans le travail de détail sur les process, les contenus et les métriques. Excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration transverse. Très opérationnel : vous ne vous contentez pas de concevoir des programmes, vous participez aux appels, analysez les chiffres et itérez vite. Français natif, anglais courant (équipes internes internationales). Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable. Ce que nous offrons Rémunération fixe: 80 k€ brut annuel + variable sur objectifs Equity Mutuelle Alan, titres-restaurant, accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être) Travail hybride, bureaux à Paris Team retreats et off-sites Processus de recrutement Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours. Entretien avec le hiring manager : expérience en enablement et approche pédagogique. Mise en situation : conception et animation d'un module de formation. Entretien final : valeurs et culture. Offre. Compensation: €80K • Offers Bonus • €80K • Offers Bonus Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
