We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.  Why Protolabs?   We are the leaders in digital manufacturing.  We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit.  Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds.  We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do.  It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.  Join our team as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead! This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands.   Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts  fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert.   We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain. The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority. What You Will Do: Technical leadership & core development Drive core development of transformative capabilities. Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives. Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management. Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases. Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner. Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups. Market observation & innovation Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company. Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability. Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers. Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements. Cross-organisation delivery & architecture Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions. Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review. Platform & environment Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment. Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability. Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery. Mentoring & influencing Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews. Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them. Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization. What You Bring: Technical 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data. Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers). Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes. Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt). Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs. Cloud-native, building scalable, secure, and compliant production systems. MLOps background: CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring/observability, IaC, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Prefect, Weights & Biases, or equivalents). Familiarity with backend systems principles, including API serving, containerization, distributed compute, security considerations. Leadership & Collaboration Demonstrated ability to lead technically without formal authority: mentoring engineers, design/PR/documentation reviews, and aligning stakeholders across teams. Experience owning architecture end-to-end: drafting, sharing, and driving sign-off of architectural designs across multiple teams. Experience working in Agile environments — contributing to Scrum ceremonies, breaking work into increments, and collaborating closely with product and engineering management in iterative delivery. Ability to lead through ambiguity and early-stage environments; proactive, systematic problem solving. Ability to translate emerging technology into business value — framing opportunities, scoping with product and engineering partners, and identifying integration requirements. Excellent communication skills across global departments: able to align engineers, product/engineering management, and leadership, and to present technical opportunities to both engineering and business audiences. Mindset Builder mentality: pragmatic, resourceful, iterative. Curiosity and willingness to experiment while ensuring quality and security. Critical thinking in uncertain or rapidly evolving contexts Bonus Points If You Have : Experience with AWS managed services.  Experience with manufacturing/industrial ML applications.  Experience with geometric/spatial data: point clouds, meshes, voxel grids, or CAD - derived representations.  Experience with vector databases, scalable retrieval architectures, guard railing LLMs, and prompt engineering.  Experience collaborating in international teams across time zones.  What's In It For You: Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter. Annual company bonus. We celebrate success together! Employees are not only rewarded for their achievements but also for contributing to the overall success of the business. Wellness and well-being with access to OpenUp psychologists, practice mindfulness with Headspace and tons more. Doggo-friendly office. We are big pet lovers and fully encourage hanging out with your (and your colleagues’) furry friends in the office Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration. We offer learning and development days to be used for training or on volunteering, money to spend on learning courses, events, trainings, Access to our in-house LEARN platform with diverse courses, training, and workshops, In-house 3D Printing and much more! Follow us on Instagram to see what Life at Protolabs is all about! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.   With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.   Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.   We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.   Who we’re looking for Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.   Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.   What you’ll be doing You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.   You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.   Strategy and leadership Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets. Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs. Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product. Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped. Technical SEO and architecture Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content. Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages. Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility. Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection. GEO Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages. Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment. Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves. Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms. Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks. Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready. Content and topical authority Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent. Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing. Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output. Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice. Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire. Measurement and reporting Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders. What success looks like Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets. A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors. The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility. Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.   In terms of your experience and skills: Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment. Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed. A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking. A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale. A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps. Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings. A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership. A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment. Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams. Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools. Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have. Our offer A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home. A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time. A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do. Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform. A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500. A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role. A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance. An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience. The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year. An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day. Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience. Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page .   We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. raw.title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
raw.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Who we’re looking for

Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.

 

Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.

 

You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.

 

Strategy and leadership

  • Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets.

  • Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs.

  • Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product.

  • Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped.

Technical SEO and architecture

  • Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content.

  • Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages.

  • Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility.

  • Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection.

GEO

  • Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages.

  • Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment.

  • Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves.

  • Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms.

  • Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks.

  • Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready.

Content and topical authority

  • Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent.

  • Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing.

  • Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output.

  • Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice.

  • Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire.

Measurement and reporting

  • Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders.

What success looks like

  • Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets.

  • A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors.

  • The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility.

  • Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment.

  • Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed.

  • A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking.

  • A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale.

  • A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps.

  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings.

  • A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment.

  • Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams.

  • Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools.

  • Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have.

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience.

  • The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

Stagiair(e) Social Media Creative

32-40 uur

Ben jij iemand die graag creatief bezig is, helemaal thuis is op social media en het leuk vindt om met de nieuwste trends aan de slag te gaan? Vind je het leuk om video's te maken en te editen, nieuwe ideeën te bedenken en content te creëren die écht opvalt? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Bij BERG krijg je de ruimte om jouw creativiteit volop in te zetten. Je draait echt mee in ons team en krijgt de vrijheid om zelf ideeën aan te dragen, content te maken en projecten op te pakken. Geen stage waarbij je alleen meekijkt, maar een plek waar je zelf aan de slag gaat, veel leert en jouw ideeën werkelijkheid ziet worden. Samen maken we er een creatieve en vooral leuke stage van!

Create your FUTURE

Als stagiair(e) Multi Media Design word jij onderdeel van ons creatieve Social Media team binnen de Branding afdeling. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw creativiteit te laten zien en werkt mee aan allerlei gave projecten. Van social media content tot 360 campagnes: jij helpt mee om BERG op een creatieve manier onder de aandacht te brengen.

 Wat ga je zoal doen?

·         Je bedenkt, ontwerpt en maakt toffe content voor onze social media kanalen.

·         Je gaat aan de slag met videomontage en grafisch ontwerp, van pakkende reels tot opvallende visuals.

·         Je helpt onze social media kanalen dagelijks up-to-date te houden.

·         Je ondersteunt bij influencer samenwerkingen en denkt mee over creatieve mogelijkheden.

·         Je werkt samen met ons creatieve team aan video- en designprojecten.

·         Je helpt mee aan onze 360 graden campagnes en krijgt een kijkje achter de schermen bij verschillende marketingactiviteiten.

 

En het leukste? Er is volop ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën en creatieve input! Zie jij een trend voorbijkomen die perfect bij BERG past? Of heb je een origineel idee voor een video? Laat maar zien!

100% YOU
Jij bent iemand die niet alleen graag creatief bezig is, maar ook niet bang is om initiatief te nemen. Je hebt gevoel voor design, weet wat er speelt op social media en krijgt energie van het maken van content die echt opvalt.

Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken, maar kunt ook prima zelfstandig aan de slag. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende projecten, denkt graag mee en houdt ervan om nieuwe dingen te leren.

Daarnaast ben jij een enthousiaste tweede- of derdejaars hbo-student Communication & Multimedia Design (of een vergelijkbare opleiding).

Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Je hoeft natuurlijk nog niet alles te kunnen. Je komt tenslotte bij ons om te leren! Enthousiasme, creativiteit en de drive om jezelf te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
Een stage bij BERG is allesbehalve saai! Je krijgt de kans om jezelf zowel creatief als professioneel te ontwikkelen, wordt onderdeel van een gezellig team en werkt aan projecten die je straks met trots aan je portfolio kunt toevoegen.

Safety or Fraud-related area.</li> <li>Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks&nbsp; </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Conduct ongoing feedback, performance, and compensation reviews.</li> <li><strong>Product Discovery &amp; Planning:</strong> Partner closely with Product Managers and the team during early-stage discovery to map out the technical strategy for future product initiatives and come up with the delivery plan.</li> <li><strong>Delivery:</strong> Lead the team’s delivery against the product roadmap while maintaining team's health.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Leadership:</strong> Highly skilled at building engineering teams, hiring new talent, setting clear scope, and managing priorities to keep the team focused and motivated.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Foundations:</strong> Background in backend engineering (ideally handling external API structures, webhook payloads, and cross-service async communication). raw.description:
Finance Controller

Location: Netherlands

Start date: Q1 2027

Compensation: €70k - €80k annually (depending on experience)

Employment type: Full-time (contractor if outside Netherlands)

About DTACT

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

The Role

We are looking for a Finance Controller to own DTACT’s finance function end-to-end as we continue to scale internationally. Reporting into the COO, you’ll take full ownership of accounting, collections, financial analytics, budgeting, and compliance (including our Dutch statutory obligations) — acting as the single point of accountability for finance in the business today. This is a hands-on, mid-level role: you’ll be expected to run the entire finance function largely on your own in the near term, while also bringing the leadership mindset and ambition to grow the function — and your own role — as DTACT expands.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end accounting operations — AP/AR, general ledger, and month end/year-end close — ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting.

  • Manage the full collections process: invoicing, aging follow-up, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Build and maintain finance analytics (dashboards, reports) that give leadership clear, real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle, partnering with department leads to track actuals against plan.

  • Ensure full compliance with Dutch tax and statutory reporting requirements (VAT, annual accounts) and manage relationships with external accountants, auditors, banks, and tax advisors.

  • Partner with People Operations on payroll processing and accuracy across jurisdictions, and own administration of the employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).

  • Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows.

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of a full finance function — ideally within tech in a startup or scale-up environment.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory compliance requirements and payroll.

  • Proven ability to independently manage accounting, collections, budgeting, and financial analytics without a large supporting team.

  • Strong analytical skills and financial modeling ability; comfortable turning data into clear, actionable insights.

  • Leadership potential and genuine ambition to grow into a finance leadership role as the team and company scale.

  • A hands-on, “roll up your sleeves” attitude, paired with the ability to think and plan strategically.

  • Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch.

What's in for you

  • Competitive compensation and equity participation, including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success.

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs.

  • A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication, empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams.

  • Generous time off, including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Home office support, including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace.

  • An international and diverse team, where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives.

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.
